title: Creamy Italian Pasta
description: A classic Italian dish made with pasta, creamy sauce, and a touch of parmesan. Perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt the italian silky over medium heat. Add the aromatic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2-3 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Stir in the parmesan until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
